During the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces, led by a [[Unidentified Jedi (Varda's killer)|member of the Jedi Order]], performed a [[Bombing run|bombing raid]] on a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] settlement. One of the victims of the attack was a female named [[Varda]], who was pregnant with the child of [[Dorjander Kace]], a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who had been captured earlier in the war and was living among the Mandalorians.
